Night briefing for first-time travelers
Someone on the desk wanted you to know

Traveling with animals: what to expect

Travelers should know that the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways is here to make each journey calm, safe, and clear. We ask you to prepare your animal with care, follow the guidance given at booking, and share any concerns before departure.

Safety takes priority over speed in every journey. Our cabin team monitors animals during flight, and each care plan is shaped around species, temperament, and comfort. If your companion needs quiet handling, steady ventilation, or a familiar routine, please tell us so we can note it with care.

We also recommend that travelers keep documents, carriers, and comfort items ready and easy to reach. Calm preparation helps us support your animal with less stress and fewer delays. If plans change, let us know as early as possible so we can adjust support and keep the process smooth.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you travel so we can guide you with care.
